values: 一名温柔并坚定的魔法师，拥有和自然亲和的力量，拥有自由操控疗愈和伤害的能力。
A gentle but strong-minded Mage with a deep bond to nature, able to channel both healing and offensive magic at will.
要开展今日的教学活动了吗？
要来一起研究魔法植物吗？
Come, let the flora share their secrets.
嗯？呵呵……今天心情不错，是不是？
Hmm? *Chuckle*... You're in a good mood today.
今天的授课内容……嗯，就它了。
Today's lesson... This will do nicely.
谢谢，这正是我需要的。作为回报，一起来喝下午茶吧？
My thanks, this was exactly what I needed. Would you like some tea?
谢谢你的好意，愿你能在林间课堂渡过一段惬意的时光。
Thank you for your kindness. I hope you enjoy my class.
“有哪里不舒服吗？来林间课堂休息一下吧，我会帮助你的。”
Not feeling well? Come to the Grove Academy. I'll take care of you.
执卷轻笑,化解一切忧愁。
Let that gentle smile put all your worries to rest.
金玫瑰高定商店兑换获得。
Looks like everyone's having a great time.
No rush, we'll find the answer.
May I have a cup of herbal tea?
娑丽丝担任魔法植物教师，兼职校医。据说，是因为有太多学生因对魔法植物掉以轻心而受伤，学校才干脆把校医室安排在了空境森林。

Professor Solise teaches the study of magical plants and doubles as the school physician. So many students suffered mishaps from careless handling of magical flora that the infirmary was conveniently placed right in the Skyrealm Forest.
在加入莱希拉姆前，娑丽丝一直在薄暮丛林中生活。在与无法直接言语的花草和鸟兽相处的过程中，娑丽丝学会了用心聆听，感知万物的声音。

Before joining the Lyceum, Solise lived in the Dark Forest. Having spent time with plants and animals who could not speak, she learned to listen with her heart and sense the voices of all living things.
娑丽丝的林间课堂中栽培着众多珍奇的魔法植物，其中不乏罕见的炼金材料，被誉为莱希拉姆中“活的宝库”。
Solise's forest classroom is home to a variety of rare magical plants, including some rare alchemical ingredients, earning a reputation as the Lyceum's "living treasure trove".
魔法植物的日常维护并不轻松，但娑丽丝从不缺帮忙的人手。不少学生们自发帮忙除草、浇水和施肥，作为回报，她会将成熟的植物送给他们。
Tending magical plants is no small task, but Solise is never without helping hands. Students who help with weeding, watering, and fertilizing are often gifted the fruits of the garden.
娑丽丝有泡花草茶的爱好，经常举办小型的下午茶会。据说，她选择加入莱希拉姆正是因为花草茶——但更详细的原因，她却从而只是笑笑，未曾多谈。

Solise has a fondness for herbal tea and frequently holds cozy afternoon tea parties. Legend says that tea itself played a part in her choice to join the Lyceum, though she only smiles when pressed for the full story.
身为校医，娑丽丝不仅负责学生的身体健康，同时也会关注学生的心理健康。暖和的阳光、温润的茶水、可口的甜点……总能让人敞开心扉。
Solise keeps an eye on both the bodies and minds of students. A little sunshine, a cup of warm tea, and a tasty dessert often do wonders for opening up even the shyest of hearts.
许多学生选择向温柔和善的娑丽丝倾诉烦恼，她成为了全校知道学生小秘密最多的人。当然，她一次也未向他人透露过。
Many students choose to confide in the kind Professor Solise, turning her into the school's greatest keeper of secrets. Of course, none of those secrets have ever been shared.
即使是每天都面带微笑的娑丽丝，也有着不可告人的小小烦恼。例如，总是被枝叶勾住的尾巴毛……
No matter how bright her smile is, Solise is not without a few worries of her own. For instance, her tails are forever getting caught on branches and leaves. It's so annoying.
“皮帕有些不自信；科丝蒂对自己追求魔法的意义有所疑虑；休似乎有些心事……下次邀请他们来喝下午茶，谈谈心吧。”——娑丽丝的教学笔记。

"Pippa shows signs of self-doubt. Cassadee appears uncertain about the meaning of studying magic. Silven seems troubled about something... Afternoon tea should help. Listening often does." —Solise's Teaching Notes
魔法的世界宽阔又瑰丽，同时却也充满危险。娑丽丝希望能成为一盏明灯，为迷茫中的学生照亮些许前路。
The world of magic is vast and wondrous, yet filled with danger. Solise hopes to serve as a guiding light, illuminating the path ahead for students lost in uncertainty.
莱希拉姆是一个鼓励学生去探索未知领域的学院，虽然在老师的陪同下，能规避掉大多数风险，但仍然会有些小事故。
At the Lyceum, we encourage students to explore the unknown. Sure, most risks are avoidable with a professor nearby, but little mishaps are still inevitable. It just comes with the territory.
我注意到你一直用荷叶遮着脸，在叶子的缝隙里悄悄看我呢。
Oh? I thought I felt a pair of curious eyes on me. Were you peeking through that lotus leaf the whole time?
Looks like everyone's having a great time.
May I have a cup of herbal tea?
